subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Should the first accepted fix be the focused WebChat-visible unresumable-notice path from the linked PR, or should maintainers require a broader restart-recovery design before merging anything for this issue?
rationale: Current source confirms the WebChat notice gap, but the issue names three different solution directions with different behavior and session-state tradeoffs.

options.title: Review the linked notice PR first
options.body: Treat the transcript notice as the immediate safety fix, then track restart deferral and durable inbound persistence separately if still needed.

options.title: Require a broader recovery design
options.body: Hold the focused PR until maintainers choose one design covering restart deferral, durable user-message persistence, and user-facing unrecoverable notices.

options.title: Move to a broader canonical issue
options.body: Close or supersede this issue only if maintainers decide another open restart-recovery tracker should own the full WebChat loss behavior.

recommendation.title: Review the linked notice PR first
recommendation.body: Treat the transcript notice as the immediate safety fix, then track restart deferral and durable inbound persistence separately if still needed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has relevant delivery-mirror and restart-deferral history and is the best available routing candidate for the product tradeoff rather than only the PR branch mechanics.
